topic.title: What three impulse online orders a month cost over 15 years

title: How much do impulse orders really cost you in 15 years?
description: Three impulse online orders of ₹1,200 each, every month for 15 years, against the same money in a monthly SIP at an assumed 11% a year. Returns are assumptions, not assured. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.

lines.text: Just one thousand two hundred rupees for one more order?
three of them a month adds up to three thousand six hundred rupees.
Over fifteen years, that's six point five lakh rupees gone on impulse orders.
Put that three thousand six hundred rupees into a monthly SIP at eleven percent a year, and watch it grow.
It could become sixteen point five lakh rupees.
Wait a day before you press buy. Comment your last impulse buy.
